settings.label: Microsoft 365 client secret
settings.description: The client secret of the Entra app registration the connector exchanges for a Microsoft Graph token (app-only). The oauth binding's client_secret_ref_default points at this name.

auth_bindings.name: m365-mail
auth_bindings.description: Microsoft Graph mail OAuth access (token injected as bearer). The guided config-writer (`configure_oauth_binding`) writes the system/oauth.yaml + system/egress.yaml rows from this template (client_credentials for app-only; delegated uses `wild oauth login`). The app registration and its client secret are created in Microsoft Entra (the obtain page).
